checks.exercise: Standing strict overhead press; front and side phase sheets and both final 32-frame sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Single plated barbell, level shaft following both hands; no dumbbell or machine substitution.
checks.setup: Stable upright stance; full body and raised plates stay within frame.
checks.hands: Both grip sockets stay on bar; central shaft/body clearance remains positive in 481 samples. Finger wrap visually checked at preview scale.
checks.feet: Both feet and toes remain fixed throughout cycle.
checks.movement: Bar clears front of face, retracts overhead, elbows reach 164.6 degrees; controlled return and matching loop pose.

checks.exercise: Seated neutral-grip cable row; front/side pose sheets and both final video sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Bench, inclined footplates, narrow two-handle attachment, cable tower and moving stack visible.
checks.setup: Upright seated torso, hips supported by bench; feet placed against inclined plates.
checks.hands: Both palms track handle; maximum sampled grip error below 4e-15 scene units.
checks.feet: Feet/toes stationary and supported through pull and return.
checks.movement: Handle approaches abdomen while elbows travel back; one-second contracted hold, return to extended arms. Stack rise matches cable extension.

checks.exercise: Bodyweight parallel-bar dips; front/side pose sheets and both final video sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Two fixed parallel bars and stable floor bases, without added weights or bench substitution.
checks.setup: Slight forward torso inclination maintained, bent knees and feet suspended behind body.
checks.hands: Fixed neutral grips remain on both bars throughout 481 sampled poses.
checks.feet: Feet remain above apparatus floor plane throughout cycle; no leg swing.
checks.movement: Controlled lowering to 83.7-degree elbows then extension to 168.2 degrees; fixed grips and continuous loop.

limits: Visual review of sampled front/side poses and encoded light/dark sheets; browser playback, seeking and looping independently checked for all nine files.
Procedural illustration with simplified equipment; no exhaustive collision certification, production deployment or phone verification.
